title: Initial work-cell update rule
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, a binary input $w$, a work tape $\tau$, a cell position $z\in\mathbb Z$, and a finite list of bits $l$. If the first bit of $l$ is true, its second bit records whether $z=0$, and its designated chain bit is false, then the local work-cell update rule applied to $l$ yields the time-zero encoding of whether the work-tape head is at $z$, the content of cell $z$, and the work-chain value at $z$.
hypotheses_covered: second list bit equals the indicator of z=0
